Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer, __and wherein the medial section comprises a material selected from the group consisting of metal, plastic, composite, honeycomb, and fiber-reinforced plastic__.

Claim 282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, __wherein the medial section comprises a metal material__.

Claim 283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 282, __wherein the metal material comprises a honeycomb structure__.

Claim 284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, __wherein the medial section comprises a composite material formed by combining two or more distinct materials__.

Claim 285 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, __further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the medial section, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section__.

Claim 286 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, __wherein the plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring__.

Claim 287 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 286, __wherein the weld ring is continuous around the perimeter__.

Claim 288 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, __wherein the weld ring is configured to secure the cutting segments to the tool__.

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 285, __further including an inner ring coupled to an inner perimeter of the medial section, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft__.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, __wherein the inner ring includes a central opening__.

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, __further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous__.

Claim 294 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, __wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section__.
